doc.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Making a living in Los Angeles and calling musicians
summary: Little studio work remains; he lives on jazz gigs, casuals and Social Security, using pick-up groups.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Is there enough work in the Los Angeles area for a jazz musician that doesn’t want to get into the studios these days?
Not too well. You must heard the joke the Polish jazz musician that got into it for the money? Haven’t you heard that joke?
You haven’t? Okay, so I told you.
There you go. That just about sums it up. The Polish jazz musician—
That got into jazz for the money. I thought you had heard that.

Because it’s pretty hard to, I don’t know I guess some people have some outside things that they do but yeah I probably make it on little jazz gigs and casuals, and of course at my stage, Social Security and a little pension and the jazz gigs and the casuals. But of course there’s not that much studio work around. Still hoping to get some more recordings some day. I don’t know if I’ll have to pay for them myself or what, or some small label, or what.
When you get a gig in a jazz club, maybe a new one, do you have a circle of people that you call then?
You know I don’t have a mailing list. Many people—
No but I mean to get the musicians to play with you.
Oh you mean the musicians not the people?

Oh just people you know around town that do it — the guitar player or piano player. I used to work a lot with Frank Strazzeri and he was using Bill Perkins on some things. I don’t get that many gigs as leader, occasionally, I just use some people that might be free

that you work with. I remember doing a gig when I had a little group, at some little restaurant, I had Ross Tompkins, Lawrence Marable, Jeff Hamilton. Pick-up groups. He’s not available, get someone else. Some other thing with John Heard on bass or just some of the better people here that are around that are available.
